# orgmap

> Map of the 99 GitHub organizations, 4 accounts and 4,988 repositories (573 original, 4,415 research forks, 199 private) of Professor Codephreak, plus 11 related organizations held by other accounts. Generated 2026-09-29 from the GitHub API.

Rules for reading it:
- Private repositories are listed by name, brief description and address only, until release. Do not infer more about them.
- Related organizations are held outside the Professor-Codephreak account; only their public repositories are listed.
- Forks are research: each one studies the work of its upstream project. In orgmap.json, `fork: false` is original work and `fork: true` is the research library.

## Data

- [orgmap.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Professor-Codephreak/orgmap/main/orgmap.json): everything, as JSON. Keys: totals, sites, accounts, organizations, related_organizations; each entry has a repositories list
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Professor-Codephreak/orgmap/main/README.md): the human index
